quirks.summary: This Idox install publishes NO documents: no application has a documents tab, and there is no external-document link either.
quirks.detail: Checked four applications from a June 2026 validated-date search (keyVals _BLCKP_DCAPR_69519, _69498, _69501, _69506) on 2026-09-29. Every summary page offers constraints, contacts, dates, details, neighbourComments, printPreview, relatedCases and summary -- and no documents tab. Constructing applicationDetails.do?activeTab=documents returns HTTP 200 with zero file links. There is no externalDocuments tab and no link out to a document store anywhere on the detail page. This is NOT the external-DMS trap (where a store exists on another host): there is no route to documents from this portal at all. Search and case metadata are fully scriptable.
quirks.workaround: Use the portal for references, dates, constraints and case metadata. For the documents themselves the portal has nothing to offer -- ask the council directly or check whether a committee report route carries them.

quirks.summary: keyVals are the underscore form (_BLCKP_DCAPR_69519), so a [A-Z0-9]+ grep matches nothing and a full result set reads as empty.
quirks.detail: Confirmed 2026-09-29. This is why the 2026-09-16 survey recorded 'advanced search returned nothing' here.
quirks.workaround: Match keyVal up to the next &, quote or whitespace.

quirks.summary: Returns an HTML 'Server Problem ... Try again later' page under HTTP 500 when requests come too fast.
quirks.detail: Seen 2026-09-29 after repeated runs inside a few minutes. It clears after a rest and is not a block or a bad request -- but it is indistinguishable from one if you are only reading status codes.
quirks.workaround: Pace at 5s+ and rest the host after an error rather than retrying.
